description: A picture of the run as a PNG image. `view` changes what is drawn first: mode (volume|slice|projection), field (index, see describe), species, log, lo, hi, sliceAxis, slicePos, minRho, opacity, yaw, pitch, dist, tx, ty, tz, zoom, cx, cy, showBlocks, contours, nContours, fog, surfaceOpacity, light, box, fieldLines, fieldLineCount, fieldLineFloor, mirrorImages, turnWithFrame, colormap, tf, autoRange. Settings persist for later screenshots. `native` saves a plane at the grid's own resolution (one pixel per finest cell), with any overlays in margins beside it.

layout.description: 'over': the overlays over the picture's edges, as in a movie; 'beside': in margins around it, covering nothing. Default 'beside' with native, else 'over'

native.description: One pixel per cell of the finest level (the grid's own resolution, up to the largest texture): true or 'box' for the whole box, 'view' for the part in view. A plane only (a 2D run, a slice or a projection); not with width or height

save_path.description: Also write the PNG to this file

status.description: The status line: grid, simulation time, point masses, mesh (default false)

name: screenshot
